svg.title: The ITCZ over West Africa in January and July
svg.desc: Map of West Africa showing the approximate position of the Inter-Tropical Convergence Zone near the coast, about 5–8°N, in January and far inland, about 18–20°N, in July. South of the ITCZ the moist south-west monsoon blows in from the Atlantic, bringing rain; north of it the dry north-east trade wind (harmattan) blows from the Sahara.
